purpose: correct missing-corner recesses and false rectangular sidewalls

entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
The user identified a structural error: hexagonal cards beneath rectangular top cards were incorrectly depicted as complete rectangular sidewalls with a small triangle pasted on the front. The task is to show the genuinely MISSING HEXAGON CORNERS and the recessed space they create.
R is a clipped rectangle. H is a pointed vertical hexagon whose whole footprint is contained inside R. N is a top-notched rectangle and behaves like R at the front corners.
CRITICAL PHYSICS:
R-H-R top-to-bottom: the upper rectangular corners OVERHANG the narrower middle H. A recessed dark cavity is visible at the front-left and front-right, bounded by the upper R lip and the lower R support shelf. The lower R paper surface receives deep occlusion shadow. There is NO pale or gold rectangular middle sidewall in these missing-corner regions. The channel must read as DEPTH under an overhang, not as a black painted stripe. Show a narrow illuminated lower shelf, upper-lip underside shadow, and the H surface/wall farther in ONLY where actually visible.
R-R-H: the two R layers project beyond the lowest H at the corners. Under those overhanging corners is the dark ground/contact shadow. There is NO complete rectangular base on the lowest level.
R-H-H: both lower H layers are narrower at the corners. The top R overhang is more evident. Two genuine aligned H layers support it centrally; no false rectangular foot or two rectangular side strips.
R-R-R is the control case: all three rectangular paper edges align continuously, no corner recess.
The small front-center tip is part of a whole hexagonal sheet, NOT an attached triangle. It must not be enlarged past the R footprint merely to advertise H. Keep layers touching where paper exists, all lying flat and aligned; do not spread/fan/float the cards, no exploded view, no pulled-out hidden card. Do not punch holes through the top card. R-H-R recesses are not transparent holes through the bottom R.
STYLE INVARIANTS: Use the same intact pale warm-gray paper, dark ink-brown narrow frame bands, subtle gray-gold edge lines and clean precise handcrafted look from the art reference. No main spell picture, curls, cracks, decorative damage, gems, neon, wood block or metal box. All card faces remain blank. Dark cavity shading should be clearly deeper than the matte dark frame band; keep the actual paper lip thin and readable.

Input image1 is the CORRECTED STRUCTURE REFERENCE, a 2x2 close-up comparison. Light areas indicate actual paper; dark missing-corner regions indicate shadowed recess or ground, never extra paper. Input image2 is only the prior ART STYLE reference; its continuous false rectangular sidewalls are precisely the error to fix. Do not copy that error.
Render a high-quality enlarged 2x2 study: top-left R > R > R, top-right R > H > R, bottom-left R > R > H, bottom-right R > H > H. Keep these short labels and title "HEXAGON RECESS — CORRECTED". Add only the short note "Display thickness x2" outside the artwork. No other paragraphs or long captions. Use image1's same aligned camera and thin layer arrangement, with enough depiction of recessed shadows to make the physical differences clear. The frame art follows image2; the corner voids follow image1. All four cases equally large, with enough margin below to see the side profile. Preserve identical total thickness between cases; differences come from missing footprint, not lifting the sheets apart.

Preserve the top-card designs, ink-brown frames, paper colors, title/labels, exact ordering, and quiet background. Three columns are top R, H, N; four rows are lower RR, HR, RH, HH. Every complete pile still contains exactly THREE sheets.
The main visible corrections are R and N columns in HR, RH and HH rows: eliminate false continuous rectangular side strips wherever H has missing corners, reveal the recessed channel/support shelf or ground accordingly. Keep the R/N upper face intact. H-top cases must retain genuinely exposed rectangular lower corners where appropriate. N notches still reveal lower paper. Do not add any corner gap to all-R control cases. Use the corrected reference to determine exactly where physical paper exists.
Make the cavities read as actual inward space via an upper overhang lip, deep narrow shadow and surviving lower surface; do NOT replace the pale middle stripe with an equally flat black decorative stripe. Keep paper thin. No wider triangular sticker or extra card. Preserve the 3x4 matrix and each T=... / lower-sequence label from image1. Add a small outside note "Display thickness emphasized" if needed, without removing any labels.
